study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: number of cervical exams performed during labor
Women who did not develop LEAF
white blood cell count at admission
cohort: 182 women from the LIFECODES pregnancy cohort who delivered between 2007 and 2008 at Brigham and Women's Hospital
finding: No association was found between maternal inflammatory biomarker concentrations measured during early- and mid-pregnancy and the odds of developing LEAF.
mod_finding: Women who did not develop labor epidural associated fever (LEAF) were more likely to have induced labor compared to those who did develop LEAF.
